intent: Analyze thermal throttling and potential GPU bottlenecking in Asus ROG G17
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling and Potential GPU Bottleneck
suggested_solution: Monitor system temperatures and GPU temperatures during gameplay to identify potential thermal throttling.
Run stress tests (e.g., MSI Afterburner) to evaluate CPU/GPU usage, temperature, and power draw during gameplay.
Update NVIDIA drivers to the latest version (496.10) and ensure proper BIOS updates.
Consider adjusting system settings or tweaking GPU performance to optimize performance.
